callees.name: _is_metadata_sidecar
callees.pre_condition: filename is a non-empty string representing a file basename found during directory traversal.
callees.post_condition: Returns True when filename identifies a generated FM-Agent metadata sidecar file — a specification or callee-information file that must be excluded from the extracted function file listing; returns False when filename identifies an extracted function source file or any other non-sidecar file.
